protocol: TPAMI V9 prospective tracking-provenance audit protocol

outcome_independence.statement: Every rule below was fixed before any V9 tracker, post-processing, metric, STV or ranking outcome existed.

role_vocabulary_note: SCHEMA A1: documentation role and structural audit mode are INDEPENDENT axes. `documentation_role` is derived only from census documentation status and documented split; it never encodes structural behaviour. `audit_mode` is derived only from structural family, corpus availability and documentation-executability; it never encodes documentation status. NON_ROW_ADDITIVE_STRUCTURAL is REMOVED as a documentation role; the non-row-additive property is now carried by audit_mode = NON_ROW_ADDITIVE_S0_S2 together with structural_family. Documentation status is never inferred from structural behaviour, and vice versa.

MOT17.source_split: MOT17 train (labelled), FRCNN detector copy only
MOT17.detector_copy_rule: MOT17 ships DPM/FRCNN/SDP copies of each base sequence with byte-identical ground truth; exactly one copy (FRCNN) is used so the seven base sequences are counted once.
MOT17.frame_range_rule: Verbatim from ByteTrack tools/convert_mot17_to_coco.py:57-58 and reproduced identically in Deep-OC-SORT data/tools/convert_mot17_to_coco.py:57-58: image_range = [num_images//2 + 1, num_images - 1] over 0-indexed images; image i maps to 1-indexed frame i+1, so the retained native frame range is [num//2 + 2, num].
MOT17.frame_index_convention: 1-indexed; rebased to 1..val_half_length by subtracting rebase_offset = num//2 + 1
MOT17.gt_source: MOT17 train gt/gt_val_half.txt emitted by the frozen converter; per-sequence sha256 above
MOT17.ignore_crowd_semantics: MOTChallenge gt column 7 (flag) must equal 1; class column 8 must equal 1 (pedestrian). Classes {3,4,5,6,9,10,11} are non-person and dropped; classes {2,7,8,12} are ignore-person regions and are neither scored nor counted as reference identities. Visibility (column 9) is NOT thresholded.
MOT17.evaluator_configuration: TrackEval MOT17 val_half; identical config for every comparable pipeline
MOT17.population_manifest_hash_spec: sha256 over the sorted concatenation of per-sequence (sequence, native_frames_retained, rebase_offset, val_half_length, gt_sha256) records
MOT17.shared_by: All quantitatively comparable MOT17 deployments use THIS population. Deep-OC-SORT's documented MOT17-val is the same second-half split (identical converter rule), so no pipeline selects its own population.

MOT20.intended_rule: Analogous frozen split: labelled MOT20 train sequences MOT20-01/02/03/05, one common second-half population under the identical image_range rule as MOT17 (Deep-OC-SORT ships data/tools/convert_mot20_to_coco.py with the same rule).
MOT20.blocking: No MOT20 corpus is present; the population manifest cannot be materialised or hashed.
MOT20.note: Rule is frozen now; only materialisation is deferred. Cells remain in the universe.

DanceTrack.intended_rule: Official DanceTrack val split as distributed. The census found no documented validation path defining another population, so the official val split governs.
DanceTrack.note: Rule is frozen now; only materialisation is deferred.

wording_contract.required: State that the repository's documented TEST-set post-processing rule was applied unchanged to a pre-specified validation population.
wording_contract.forbidden: Do not state or imply that the repository documents post-processing use on the validation split for these cells.
wording_contract.correction_note: This corrects over-broad wording that appeared in frozen V8 ('under their documented post-processing rules' applied to a validation population). V8 is NOT edited; the correction binds V9 language only.
wording_contract.exempt: PRIMARY_DOCUMENTED_VALIDATION cells (Deep-OC-SORT; StrongSORT++ MOT17) may state that validation use is documented, because it is.

counting_units.deployment_definition: one released tracker/pipeline configuration and its audited post-processing call

lineage_groups.L: ByteTrack-derived dti; six deployments; 100% identical normalized token stream for ByteTrack/OC-SORT/Hybrid-SORT/SparseTrack, BoT-SORT +1 print, Deep-OC-SORT n_min default 25->30

counting_units.reporting_rule: Every future table must state BOTH deployment count and independent family count. Repository count is never family count.

row_additive_contract.R0: raw tracker output immediately before the audited interpolation stage
row_additive_contract.R2: output immediately after the frozen documented interpolation call
row_additive_contract.invariant: R0 subseteq R2 by row identity; pre-existing R0 rows field-identical up to normalised serialisation
row_additive_contract.row_identity: (sequence, frame, track_id) after the frozen parser normalisation
row_additive_contract.normalisation_allowed: numeric formatting/precision of the writer only; no coordinate or id change
row_additive_contract.on_failure: do NOT construct R1; classify the cell STRUCTURAL_DECOMPOSITION_UNAVAILABLE
row_additive_contract.R1: R0 plus only those synthesized R2 rows admitted by the frozen STV criterion; GT-informed diagnostic only; never deployable

non_row_additive_contract.forbidden: no R1 analogue may be forced
non_row_additive_contract.S0: state immediately before the audited transformation
non_row_additive_contract.undefined_rule: If the transformation rewrites values that its own regression/smoothing fit consumes, a row-subset causal decomposition is declared STRUCTURALLY_UNDEFINED. This is an allowed outcome, not a failure of the study.

gpr_reproducibility_contract.harness_rule: the harness seeds NumPy/random global state immediately before calling the unmodified upstream entry point
gpr_reproducibility_contract.replay: exactly one same-seed replay is required as reproducibility verification
gpr_reproducibility_contract.replay_is_not_a_trial: replay values must never be averaged or pooled with the first execution
gpr_reproducibility_contract.on_failure: status = REPRODUCIBILITY_FAILURE; no quantitative GPR ranking claim is licensed
forbidden: choosing a seed because of an observed output

stv.anchors: the two bracketing R0 observations of a synthesized row
stv.reference_assignment: per-frame one-to-one assignment against scoreable GT, computed on R0 BEFORE any synthesized row is introduced, and then frozen
stv.algorithm: Hungarian one-to-one on IoU with the gate applied as a hard admissibility mask before assignment
stv.licensed_phrase_rule: Only ANCHOR_ID_MISMATCH licenses 'anchors resolve, under the frozen matcher, to different ground-truth identities'. ANCHOR_UNMATCHED is non-admission, NOT demonstrated semantic error.
stv.not_a_metric: STV is a reference-side diagnostic and never a replacement tracking metric
stv.sensitivity_status: DESCRIPTIVE; the 0.5 result remains primary regardless of sensitivity outcome

primary_outcomes_non_row_additive: C-J replaced by the structural transition inventory; A, B, K, L retained
headline_rule: the reported quantities are fixed here; no post-hoc selection of which to headline

metrics.evaluator_pin_note: same evaluator family pinned in V8; commit frozen before execution
metrics.no_substitution: no metric may be substituted after results are seen
metrics.gt_parsing_contract: frozen MOTChallenge parser; identical config for every comparable pipeline

ordering.no_selective_inspection: all pairs reported, not only those that flip
ordering.estimand_warning: These are SYSTEM-LEVEL deployment orderings. A cross-pipeline ordering difference must NOT be attributed solely to the post-processing family, because tracker and detector systems differ. Within-pipeline R0->R2 deltas and between-pipeline ordering are separate estimands.

materiality.denominator_justification: The denominator is synthesized rows because the criterion concerns the composition of what the post-processor produced, not of the whole submission.
materiality.mandatory_companion: the corresponding fraction of total submitted R2 rows must ALWAYS be reported alongside, so a large conditional fraction cannot be read as a submission-wide effect

status_rules: SUPPORTED/FAILS_TO_SUPPORT only for a criterion frozen before its outcome
simple measured quantities need no hypothesis label
no confirmatory claim may be invented because a result is large
stop_conditions: population not reproducible from a frozen manifest (currently: MOT20, DanceTrack)
documented rule needs an undocumented parameter choice
evaluator configuration differs across comparable pipelines
a supposedly row-additive implementation rewrites existing rows
GPR RNG not externally fixable/replayable without changing scientific source semantics
CLI is not the actual execution path
any real V9 metric/STV outcome inspected during protocol or CLI development
stopped_cell_rule: a stopped cell remains in the universe carrying its stop reason; it is never silently removed

amendments.title: separate documentation role from structural audit mode
freeze pre-V9 outcome knowledge status; correct score and ID-rewrite implementation semantics
MOT20 mirror identity verified and frozen population materialized

interpretation_contract.HISTORICAL_OUTCOME_KNOWN_PRE_V9: may be replayed through the V9 CLI as implementation validation and as part of the systematic universe, but MUST NOT be described as a prospective V9 result
interpretation_contract.PROSPECTIVE_OUTCOME_UNSEEN_AT_V9_FREEZE: may receive prospective interpretation only if all protocol and executable conditions were frozen before execution
interpretation_contract.STOPPED_UNSEEN: outcome remains unseen because execution is stopped (e.g. corpus not acquired)
interpretation_contract.reporting_requirement: The paper must report how many EXECUTED cells were historical versus genuinely prospective. A blanket statement that all outcomes were prospectively frozen is FORBIDDEN.
